debugfile.description: Path to the debug log file

logfile.description: Path to the main log file

logmode.description: Octal file permissions for log files

logfacility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., daemon, local0); 'none' disables syslog

entity.description: Entity name shown at start of messages for log files

syslogprefix.description: Prefix added to syslog messages for filtering; empty/disabled by default

useapphbd.description: Whether to register with apphbd; 'yes' or 'no'

sendqlen.description: Send queue length from parent to child process

recvqlen.description: Receive queue length in child process
